name: Terminal
description: A glowing green-on-black terminal: typed commands with a block cursor, dim grey output, red and amber warnings, an ASCII progress bar and ASCII box diagrams, with scanlines, a soft phosphor glow and a dark vignette. The story is a terminal session: a command types itself, output scrolls out line by line, a progress bar runs, and the result lands in red or amber; a second command shows the contrast, and an ASCII comparison box sums it up.
best_use_cases: Explaining a technical idea as a terminal session
Showing a before-and-after comparison in ASCII
style: Glowing green-on-black terminal; typed commands with block cursor; dim grey output; red and amber warnings; ASCII progress bar and box diagrams; scanlines, phosphor glow, dark vignette.
